description: This file defines a utility class 'TaxUtils' with static methods for splitting tax amounts, calculating income amounts after tax, total tax calculations, and adding tax to amounts. It operates on tax components and tax group mappings, handling monetary calculations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: TaxUtils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for tax calculations, such as splitting tax amounts, calculating total taxes, and adjusting amounts for income or total including tax.

methods.name: splitTax
methods.description: Splits a given amount into its tax components based on the provided tax group mappings and date, returning a map of tax components to their respective calculated tax amounts.

methods.name: splitTaxData
methods.description: Similar to splitTax but operates on TaxComponentData objects instead of TaxComponent objects.

methods.name: incomeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the income amount after deducting the total tax from the provided gross amount.

methods.name: incomeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the income amount given a total tax mapping, subtracting total tax from the original amount.

methods.name: totalTaxAmount
methods.description: Sums up all tax amounts in a map to give the total tax amount.

methods.name: totalTaxDataAmount
methods.description: Sums up all tax amounts in a map with TaxComponentData keys to give the total tax.

methods.name: addTax
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including tax based on the original amount and applicable tax percentages for a given date.
